first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A white goose-shaped animal with a slender white neck, pointed tail, and orange feet, carrying Object A in front of its head.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A light-yellow rounded block-shaped object carried by Animal A, with a blue strip-shaped area and two dark circular spots on its surface.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with brown hair, wearing purple long sleeves, a burgundy sleeveless top, grayish-brown pants, and black shoes.

entities.name: gray street surface
entities.identification: The broad gray paved area behind the foreground roof and around the median grass.

entities.name: dark-gray tiled roof
entities.identification: The sloping dark-gray roof at the bottom of the image, covered with rows of staggered rectangular tiles.

entities.name: rooftop chimney
entities.identification: A rooftop chimney assembly consisting of a reddish-brown brick square column, a gray cap, and brown flue pipes.

entities.name: green median grass
entities.identification: The flat, light-green polygonal grass area inside the light-colored curb.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: A bench with a brown plank-like backrest and seat and dark supports.

entities.name: dark-green post
entities.identification: The thick dark-green upright post in the grass, widening at the lower portion and with a nearly black bottom section.

entities.name: blue puddle
entities.identification: The flat, blue irregular area on the street surface on the left.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A plant cart with a red tubular frame, a dark elongated box-shaped trough, and black wheels.

entities.name: black box-bin
entities.identification: The dark square-framed container to the left of Vehicle A, with a thick border, crossbars, and a dark-blue interior surface.

entities.name: small light-blue seat-surface object
entities.identification: The small light-blue object at the right end of the wooden bench seat, with a slender middle section and an angular, pointed-wing outline.

entities.name: light-colored curb
entities.identification: The beige-gray segmented narrow strip forming the boundary between the grass and the street surface.

entities.name: group of green plants
entities.identification: The upright green branches and leaves and the lighter-colored low cluster of leaves in Vehicle A's trough.

entities.name: red-brick building
entities.identification: The partially visible reddish-brown wall corner, light-colored border, and adjacent narrow dark-green strip at the top edge of the image behind the puddle.

entities.name: thin gray upright pole
entities.identification: The slender, straight gray upright pole on the grass to the right of the wooden bench.
